__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use
some rest.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The raggity dervish walks on aimlessly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dervish raggity

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use
LOTS of rest.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The large dervish watches for signs of trouble.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dervish large

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This relatively harmless snake has bright alternating bands of red, yellow
and black.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A brightly colored snake slithers along the sands.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle snake coral

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The little tail is mighty dangerous for such a small creature.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small, red scorpion scuttles away at your approach.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle scorpion small

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He's big, mean, and purple. Watch out!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A giant, purple sand worm thrusts up out of the sand and attacks!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle worm giant purple

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr:
The brass dragon steps out of the darkness and says 'Hello'.
Then adds to it, 'Prepare to die, have a nice day!'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dragon brass

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is clad in silk robes lined with gold thread. At his side
is a large, engraved cutlass. He has an especially haughty air
about him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The nomad leader sits silently in prayer.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle nomad leader

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is the nomad leader's second in command. His clothes are richly
woven of silk and gold thread. A nasty cutlass hangs at his side.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The nomad commander stands here staring suspiciously at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle nomad commander

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A proud nomad warrior stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle nomad warrior

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A young slave sits here staring at you with pleading eyes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle slave young

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The dracolich is now only bone with pieces of flesh hanging from it.
Obviously it no longer fears death.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A pile of bones rises up to form a skeletal dracolich.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dracolich lich

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This half-spider, half-drow creature is a formidable opponent.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The drider looks at you viciously while it draws its sword.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle drider drow

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The duergar could crush your head as easily as it does those rocks.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A duergar is here mining precious stones with his pick.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle duergar dwarf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The myconoid looks something like a giant mushroom (and probably
has the same effect).
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle myconoid

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The shaman shoots spores into the air.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A rather large myconoid stands here chanting in a strange tongue.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle myconoid shaman

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small oasis invites you to dive in.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dustdigger

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A very dangerous rabid camel snorts at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle camel
